summary: Opened investigation @q_snapshot_install_stale_log and recorded a source-based defect account: installSnapshot (raft.go 1930-1977) never resets the cached last log entry, while getLastEntry (state.go 160-175) prefers lastLogIndex whenever it is >= lastSnapshotIndex, so a follower whose stale suffix covers the leader's snapshot index keeps advertising a log it no longer holds, fails every prev-log check, and the leader can only re-ship the same snapshot (replication.go 240-300, 352-372) with no entry ever accepted. Added a focused in-package probe (draft/assurance_generated_test.go) that drives a real three-voter history into that state plus an untrimmed control, and requested it as the retained experiment with five comparisons (mechanism, progress, stale-claim, and two control predicates). Local runs of the same harness were construction feedback only: the follower's FSM was restored 4 -> 1365 times in 3s at an unchanged snapshot index, its applied index stayed at 83 while the cluster frontier reached 95, its cached claim stayed (98, term 2) against snapshot (83, term 3), its commit index stayed 0, and the control accepted no snapshot and caught up (83 -> 95). Incomplete: formal conclusion awaits the controller's retained receipt; monotonic-store failure mode, other TrailingLogs values, the vote-side consequence of the stale claim, and whether a larger cluster can still repair the node all remain unmeasured. Temporary build/copy directories used for the local compile check were deleted from the draft.
